prose: A Show HN project is an MCP server and API that finds text a coding agent reads but a human cannot see, such as hidden instructions in documents. Sign-up is via GitHub with 20 free pages, then a cent a page. The page presents the key as a production key with no sales call. Basis: the opening of a product page was read; claims are the vendor's own.
highlights: Detects hidden text agents read but humans cannot see.
MCP server plus API; 20 free pages, then a cent a page.
Basis: the opening of the article was read.
